items.title: Three seasons, three finals—Sudurpaschim Royals do it again
items.blurb: The Royals defeated Chitwan Rhinos in Qualifier 2 on Thursday to book a seat in the final for the third consecutive season.

items.title: Sudurpaschim reach third straight NPL final, set up title clash with Lumbini
items.blurb: Tharindu Ratnayake’s unbeaten 53 guides Sudurpaschim Royals to a three-wicket victory over Chitwan Rhinos in Qualifier 2.

items.title: At Seto Gumba, there’s more to being a nun than prayer and meditation
items.blurb: Over 80 Buddhist nuns at the monastery in western Kathmandu blend daily kung fu practice with meditation, disaster relief, environmental advocacy, and skills traditionally associated with men.

items.title: Malan’s 71 takes Chitwan to 133 against Sudurpaschim
items.blurb: Chitwan Rhinos set the Royals a target of 134 in Qualifier 2, with the winner advancing to the final against Lumbini Lions.

items.title: Chitwan Rhinos knock Kathmandu Gorkhas out and progress to Qualifier 2
items.blurb: Chitwan defeated Kathmandu by 61 runs and entered Qualifier 2, where Sudurpaschim Royals are waiting. Chitwan and Sudurpaschim will vie for a spot in the final on Thursday.

items.title: Mishara’s record century sends Chitwan into Qualifier 2
items.blurb: Chitwan Rhinos beat Kathmandu Gorkhas by 61 runs in the Eliminator after Kamil Mishara smashed an unbeaten 120, the highest individual score in Nepal Premier League history.
